description: Carrington-class extreme: Halloween 2003 with the saturated-Ap plateau extended by 24 h and F10.7 multiplied by 1.5 to model an X40+ class flare-day flux. Tsurutani+2003 estimate Dst ≈ -1760 nT for 1859, ≈ 4× Halloween's -422 nT; in 3-hourly indices that translates to longer dwell at Ap_saturation rather than a higher peak (Ap maxes at 400 by construction).
warnings: Ap saturation: rows reach the 400 ceiling; the index does not resolve magnitude beyond that point.
F10.7 = 841 SFU exceeds the predictor's training maximum of 315 SFU; predictions here are extrapolations and must be checked for monotonicity / smoothness only, not accuracy.
